// Writes blocks.heic: a 64 x 64 HEIC of four solid color blocks, through
// the Windows Imaging Component HEIF encoder.
//
// Cargo.toml of the throwaway program:
//   [dependencies]
//   windows = { version = "0.62", features = ["Win32_Foundation",
//     "Win32_System_Com", "Win32_System_Com_StructuredStorage",
//     "Win32_System_Variant", "Win32_Graphics_Imaging",
//     "Win32_Storage_FileSystem"] }
//
// Run: cargo run -- <output path>
use windows::core::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Imaging::*;
use windows::Win32::System::Com::*;

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("output path");
    unsafe {
        CoInitializeEx(None, COINIT_MULTITHREADED).ok()?;
        let factory: IWICImagingFactory = CoCreateInstance(&CLSID_WICImagingFactory, None, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER)?;
        let stream = factory.CreateStream()?;
        let wide: Vec<u16> = out.encode_utf16().chain(Some(0)).collect();
        stream.InitializeFromFilename(PCWSTR(wide.as_ptr()), 0x40000000)?; // GENERIC_WRITE
        let encoder = factory.CreateEncoder(&GUID_ContainerFormatHeif, std::ptr::null())?;
        encoder.Initialize(&stream, WICBitmapEncoderNoCache)?;
        let mut frame = None;
        let mut props = None;
        encoder.CreateNewFrame(&mut frame, &mut props)?;
        let frame = frame.unwrap();
        frame.Initialize(props.as_ref())?;
        let (w, h) = (64u32, 64u32);
        frame.SetSize(w, h)?;
        let mut fmt = GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;
        frame.SetPixelFormat(&mut fmt)?;
        println!("pixel format accepted: {:?}", fmt);
        let mut px = vec![0u8; (w * h * 4) as usize];
        for y in 0..h {
            for x in 0..w {
                let (r, g, b) = match (x / 32, y / 32) {
                    (0, 0) => (230u8, 30u8, 30u8),
                    (1, 0) => (30, 200, 40),
                    (0, 1) => (30, 40, 220),
                    _ => (240, 240, 240),
                };
                let i = ((y * w + x) * 4) as usize;
                px[i..i + 4].copy_from_slice(&[b, g, r, 255]);
            }
        }
        frame.WritePixels(h, w * 4, &px)?;
        frame.Commit()?;
        encoder.Commit()?;
        stream.Commit(STGC_DEFAULT)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
